description.en: A bundle of 12 live ASCII wallpapers, such as Moonlit, Koi Pond, Neon Rain, and Sakura Dusk, plus 5 color themes, picked from a strip above the prompt.
description.zh: 包含 12 个实时 ASCII 动画壁纸(如 Moonlit、Koi Pond、Neon Rain、Sakura Dusk)和 5 个配色主题,在输入框上方的选择条里切换。

usage.en: Run /themes in a Claude Code session in Claude Desktop and press Install extension. It sets the REACT_PROFILE=1 environment variable and, on macOS, adds a LaunchAgent. Restart Claude Desktop, then pick a theme.
usage.zh: 在 Claude Desktop 的 Claude Code 会话中运行 /themes,点击 Install extension。它会设置 REACT_PROFILE=1 环境变量,macOS 上还会添加 LaunchAgent。重启 Claude Desktop 后再选择主题。
